content:
Best Buy has now updated its giant 60th Anniversary sale with new deals and we are still tracking 25% off AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Max 2 at $120 off, and the best prices ever on AirTag 2. But today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break also features a huge $500 price drop on this 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro via Amazon, Anker’s new SmartTrack Find My wallet card down at the $25 all-time low, and a wild 50% off Unlimited 1-year talk/data plans at just $15 a month from Mint Mobile. Scope it all out down below.

Best Buy updates giant 60th Anniversary Sale with new deals: TVs from $110, up to 50% off tech, appliances $1,000 off, more

AirPods deals just dropped even lower, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 25% off, more

After summer full of solid deals on Apple’s latest AirPods lineup, just about all of them have just dropped even lower. The sought-after AirPods Pro 3 are now sitting at one of the best prices ever at 25% off, but we also saw AirPods 4 with ANC dip to the lowest price in several months and AirPods Max 2 have dropped even lower as of this morning to $120 off.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)

Super rare deal on M4 Mac mini live today at $150 off via official Apple refurb store

Update: This deal has now sold out, we will keep a close eye out for a re-stock.

There have been plenty of great deals on AirPods Pro 3 and the new AirTag 2, M5 MacBook Pro models, and more, but the latest M4 Mac mini has been incredibly elusive. Almost never even available for purchase anymore from retailers like Amazon and Best Buy where the deals used to be, we just spotted an extremely rare chance to score the 16GB/512GB M4 Mac mini courtesy of the official Apple refurb store at $150 off.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now offering the M4 Mac mini with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB storage capacity at $849 shipped.

Now even lower: Huge $500 price drop lands on this 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro via Amazon

This week ushered in some notable $400 price drops on brand new condition M5 Pro MacBook Pro configs as part of a special 1-day Apple event. However, we wanted to shine on a brighter spotlight on one of those models – this 2TB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is now $500 off at Amazon.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and the 2TB internal SSD down at $2,699 shipped right now.

This is the regularly $3,199 config that carries the upgraded 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU (as opposed to the 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU that is currently $400 off). While this machine did just see a price hike, it is now $100 under the old, much lower MSRP anyway.

Both options are solid, depending on the sort of power you need here – now $400 and $500 off the list prices, it would usually cost you an additional $200 to land the upgraded CPU/GPU, but with the deals we have right now it is only $100 more:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (Reg. $2,999)
    • 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (Reg. $3,199)
    • 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

We suspect it won’t be long before the $500 drop jumps back up, but there’s no telling whether or not it might make it through Sunday when this week’s major sale events wrap up.

Apple’s latest AirTag 2 hit Amazon all-time low pricing this week, but here’s how to score one for just $20

The Apple deals are flying this week with AirPods Pro 3 still down at 25% off and one of the best price drops to date on its latest AirPods Max 2 at $120 off. Alongside the $500 price drop on select M5 Pro MacBook Pro models, some of the more notable deals are also landing on its latest AirTag 2 trackers with both the single and the 4-pack back at all-time low pricing – but you can also score one of them down at just $20 right now too.

Amazon has now dropped the price on both the single AirTag 2 listing and the 4-pack back down to the best prices we have ever tracked since release earlier this year:

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29)
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (Reg. $99)

That brings your per Tag price down as low as $22.25 on the 4-pack, and the single AirTag 2 listing back to the Prime Day all-time low at $24.

While not a whole lot less than that, it is worth noting that Best Buy’s “excellent” open-box condition listing on the single AirTag 2 is also sitting down at the lowest we have tracked right now – you can scoop one up for just $19.99.

  • AirTag 2 “excellent” open-box $20 (Reg. $29 new) | Best Buy

While that is only $4 less than the brand new listing at Amazon and I, for one, would rather just take that route, it is indeed a lower price. Best Buy is also delivering the same deals on the new listings as well, so if you are already placing an order as part of its ongoing 60th Anniversary Sale it’s worth noting the options there too.

Apple Watch Series 11 $100 off for Anniversary week, Best Buy open-box offers from $254

Anker’s new SmartTrack Find My wallet card for iOS or Android drops to $25 Amazon all-time low

Anker recently released a brand new SmartTrack Find My Card for you wallet – its first to support both Apple’s tracking platform and Google Find Hub – and it has now dropped to a new Amazon all-time low at $25 Prime shipped.

Anker’s official EufyHome shop on Amazon is now offering the new SmartTrack Card E40 for iOS or Android down at $24.99 with free shipping for Prime members or in orders over $35.

It first landed on Amazon at $35 last month and after a light $5 price drop hit later that month, it is now seeing its first notable price drop to deliver a new Amazon all-time low.

You’re looking at nearly 30% off here and a price on par with some of the better deals we have tracked on comparable wallet tracker cards this year.

I’m personally a big fan of the Nomad Tracking Cards – they start at $35 and go up to $45 for the Pro model with 16 months of battery life before it needs a recharge – but no matter which you go with, I think everyone should have one of these things in their wallet or card carrier. I never leave the house without one.

The latest SmartTrack Card E40 from the Anker brand delivers on all of the most important features, including the wireless charging, while also working on either Apple’s Find My platform or Google Find Hub. It measures out at 1.7 mm in thickness and rings out at up to 80 dB to help track it down when you’re nearby – it, of course, loads right up into the Find My and Find Hub apps as well to see its location on the map.

Mint Mobile now offering wild 50% off Unlimited 1-year talk/data plans at just $15 a month

Mint Mobile is offering some wild deals right now on unlimited 5G/4G LTE mobile plans. While the service provider tends to offer solid value most of the year, it is currently offering its Unlimited 12-Month Plan for just $15 a month – that’s 50% off and just $180 for an entire year of unlimited talk, text, and data. Even if you don’t plan on switching your main plan right now, this price is low enough to consider as a back up or iPad line.

While you will find discounts on its 17GB and 23GB plans as well, the best value here is the 5G • 4G LTE Plan: Unlimited/MO for 12 months at just $15 a month.

  • Unlimited 12-Month Mint Mobile Plan for $15/month (50% off)

Based on the fine print here, you will need to deliver an upfront payment of $180 for the 12-month plan (equivalent to $15/mo.), but this is a seriously deep deal for folks looking to make a switch to a new provider at a discount or land a second line for another device/as a backup.

You can “activate your service immediately if your phone is eSIM compatible” but it is available across a broad range of Apple, Samsung, and Google devices. You can keep your current number and bring your own unlocked phone to the service if needs be.

Head over to the deal page for more details.

Latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits Amazon all-time low at nearly 30% off (Wired model also on sale)

As part of its late summer deals on a range of Fire tablets, Fire TVs, and Blink smart home gear, Amazon is also now delivering its best price ever on the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro and bringing back Prime Day all-time low pricing on the wired model, both at nearly 30% off the list price.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (Reg. $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (Reg. $250)

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Anker’s MagSafe power banks start down at $36 shipped this week (Loads of color options)
  • Anker’s 25W Qi2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe charger is one of the best, now at 35% off (Matching all-time low)
  • Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the best looking MagSafe stands I’ve seen, bag it for $27 (Reg. $35)
  • Twelve South’s all-in-one braided PowerCord USB-C Charger now down at $16.50 (45% off)
  • Anker’s Nano 100W 3-Port Charger comes with a 5-foot cable down at $36 today
  • Woot’s massive PC sale is now live with up to 75% off gaming desktops, monitors, coolers, and more, deals from just $5
  • This tiny display-equipped SSD enclosure has power-loss protection, and it’s just $29 today
  • Razer’s portable 11-in-1 USB-C hub just plunged to $52 all-time low (57% off)
  • Twelve South’s Find My-equipped USB-C wall charger just hit the Amazon all-time low at under $37
  • Whoa! These leather Apple Watch bands are only $6 Prime shipped (75% off)

Amazon now has AirPods Max 2 in all five colors at $120 off (One of the best prices ever)

This week’s giant 60th Anniversary sale is ushering in one of the best prices to date on Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2, and Amazon now has all five colors at $120 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s AirPods Max 2 down at $429 shipped.

Carrying the same $549 as the previous-generation set, you’re looking at a solid $120 in savings here to deliver the best price we can find right now in brand new condition from a reputable retailer.

Best Buy does have the Midnight black set down at $403.99 shipped in “excellent” open-box condition, and that is a lower price, but perhaps not quite enough lower to side-step a brand new set.

Apple unleashed a proper next-generation set of AirPods Max this year, as opposed to just a fresh coat of paint and the USB-C jack on the previous release. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, it is not going to update is over-ear options as part of next month’s new releases, so we are looking at $120 off what could be the latest and greatest Apple over-ears for some time here this week.

There has only been one other sale event to offer them for less, and that was Prime Day earlier this summer that had them selling for $30 under the deal price we have here today – stock was also rather limited and unreliable during the 4-day sale as well.

Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro units are $220 off today (Matching Prime Day deal)

While the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is my go-to recommendation for landing deals on iPhone, Apple does not sell its latest iPhone 17 Pro models there yet, and it looks like it won’t until after the 18 series lands next month. Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed listings have now returned to Prime Day pricing at up to $220 off the new list prices.

Amazon’s top-quality Premium Renewed units have been the best option for landing deals on unlocked iPhone 17 Pro units thus far. Not only are you saving hundreds, but you’re also landing the 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life” – the not “premium” renewed and refurbished listings on Amazon only come with a 90-day warranty and you won’t get the same battery life grate either.

Right now you’ll find the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models live again at up to $220 off – the 512GB is now $20 less than our previous mention as well:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)

As detailed in yesterday top picks from the Apple refurb store feature, you can land a perfectly capable iPhone 16 model with a 1-year Apple warranty starting from $699 and a 1TB 16 Pro Max at $1,269 – $330 less than the comparable 17 Pro Max, and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (Up to $330 less than series 17)
